rule: A product's Hub category comes from its manufacturer's own filing, mapped once per (supplier, division) and recorded here with that filing as the evidence. `hub` is "<speciality>:<type>" using the vocabulary in data/compare-suppliers.json, which verify.py already gates. A pair with no mapping publishes nothing: an uncategorised product is held out of the Differentiator, never guessed into a category, because a product compared against the wrong category is worse than a product missing from the table. LOU'S RULE, 25/08/2026: `hub` may be a LIST of categories instead of one, when the division's OWN evidence genuinely names products from several at once — do not pick a single category for a division that spans more than one, put it in all of them. This is still not licence to guess: a division with no clear evidence for any category is still left unmapped. See data/differentiator-map-parts/README.md.

cardiology.equip: Diagnostic cardiology equipment (ECG/Holter recorders & data management)

respiratory.snore: Anti-snoring devices (mandibular advancement, nasal dilators — distinct from CPAP/respiratory support)

theatres.perfusion: Cardiopulmonary bypass and perfusion (oxygenators, circuits, centrifugal pumps, beating-heart stabilisation)
theatres.drain: Chest/thoracic drainage systems (trocars, drainage valves, digital suction)

audiology.acc: Accessories & connectivity (streamers, remote mics, TV adapters)
audiology.lab: 3D-printing & lab manufacturing equipment for custom earmoulds/hearing-aid shells (printers, resins, scanners, mould-design software)

gastro.diag: GI physiology & motility testing (pH/reflux monitoring, manometry, submucosal lifting agents)

pharma.cold: Cold-chain storage — medical fridges, freezers & vaccine carriers

diabetes.strip: Blood glucose and ketone test strips

neuro.shockwave: Non-invasive neuromodulation & extracorporeal shockwave therapy — distinct from implantable devices (scs/dbs/sns/pns)

orthotics.materials: Orthotic fabrication materials and componentry (EVA and CAD/CAM stock, coverings, alloy bar and tubing, fixings, pads)

rehab.comms: Augmentative and alternative communication (speech-generating devices, eye gaze, switches, access and AAC software)

oncology.abl: Ablation — cryo, RF and pulsed field
oncology.radio: Radiotherapy capital equipment (linacs, gamma knife, brachytherapy afterloaders)

digital.sw: Clinical and departmental software systems (imaging, oncology, laboratory and asset-tracking)
digital.hw: Clinical IT hardware (workstations, label printers, scanners, room systems)
digital.periph: Infection-control input devices (sealed and washable keyboards and mice)
digital.tec: Technology-enabled care & telecare (falls, wander, nurse call, environmental sensors, lone-worker alerts)
digital.aac: Augmentative and alternative communication aids & environmental control (access switches, eye gaze, communication devices)

dermatology.energy: Energy-based dermatology and aesthetic devices (laser, shockwave and phototherapy platforms)

vascsurg.access: Vascular access sheaths, catheters & delivery systems

veterinary.consum: Veterinary consumables (infusion, wound management, fluid warming)

it.hw: Computer hardware (laptops, desktops, monitors, mounting & carts)

mis.maint: Maintenance of MIS instruments and equipment
